newsitem.title: USA: AmeriVest sets first and special dividend.
newsitem.headline: AmeriVest sets first and special dividend.

text.p: AmeriVest Properties Inc said on Tuesday it declared an initial quarterly dividend of $0.1125 per share and a special one-time dividend of $0.2175 per share, both payable December 23, record December 16.

"This special dividend is necessitated by the rules for real estate investment trusts (REITs) that require all its previously accumulated corporate earnings and profits be paid to stockholders prior to the end of the first year for which the company is a REIT," AmeriVest Chief Executive Officer Jim Etter said.

AmeriVest, owner of an office building, commercial industrial showroom building and four storage properties, completed its initial public offering and commenced trading on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market on November 6.
